title.en: Preserve real member identity on sign-in
title.zh: 登录时保留真实会员身份资料

purpose.en: Keep the real Clerk email visible and preserve a user-edited display name across password sign-ins.
purpose.zh: 保留真实 Clerk 邮箱，并确保用户修改的显示名称在密码重新登录后仍然保存。

en: Store normalized real email for verified and unverified members with a separate verification flag.
Preserve saved display names during Clerk synchronization.
zh: 为已验证和未验证会员保存标准化真实邮箱，并独立记录验证状态。
Clerk 同步时保留用户已保存的显示名称。

en: GreatLoveMeta Clerk session bridge, user identity records, and account identity surfaces.
zh: GreatLoveMeta Clerk 会话桥接、用户身份记录及账户身份界面。

en: Repair legacy synthetic-email accounts, bind by Clerk ID first, preserve display names, and add regression coverage.
zh: 修复历史合成邮箱账户，优先按 Clerk ID 绑定，保留显示名称，并增加回归覆盖。

en: Pass identity regression, lint, repository build and tests, deployment, and production checks.
zh: 通过身份回归、代码规范、仓库构建与测试、部署及生产检查。

en: Dedicated production account acceptance uses a non-admin test identity and never exposes credentials.
zh: 生产验收使用专用非管理员测试身份，且绝不暴露凭据。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding and its independent Clerk, user, payment, classroom, and data boundaries.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌及独立的 Clerk、用户、支付、课堂和数据边界。
